Introduction

Study Design

Experimental design overview
Element Description
Response variable (continuous) Number of moves per chess game
Response variable (binary) Game outcome (Win / Loss)
Treatment (within-subject) Cocaine consumption (pre vs. post)
Blocking factor 1 Island of residence (7 levels)
Blocking factor 2 Biological sex (male / female)
Design Repeated-measures (paired) with two blocking factors 
power_result <- pwr.t.test(
  d           = 0.25,
  sig.level   = 0.05,
  power       = 0.80,
  type        = "paired",
  alternative = "two.sided"
)
print(power_result)
## 
##      Paired t test power calculation 
## 
##               n = 127.5158
##               d = 0.25
##       sig.level = 0.05
##           power = 0.8
##     alternative = two.sided
## 
## NOTE: n is number of *pairs*
cat(sprintf("\nMinimum required sample size: %d participants\n",
            ceiling(power_result$n)))
## 
## Minimum required sample size: 128 participants

Data

df <- read_csv("chess_data.csv") %>%
  rename(
    pre_wl     = `chess_W/L`,
    pre_moves  = num_moves,
    post_wl    = `post_coke_W/L`,
    post_moves = num_moves_post
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    city      = str_trim(city),
    sex       = factor(sex),
    city      = factor(city),
    pre_win   = ifelse(pre_wl  == "w", 1L, 0L),
    post_win  = ifelse(post_wl == "w", 1L, 0L),
    move_diff = post_moves - pre_moves
  )

cat("Observations:", nrow(df), "\n")
## Observations: 135
cat("Islands:", paste(levels(df$city), collapse = ", "), "\n")
## Islands: Arcadia, Bjurholm, Hayarano, Kiyobico, Reading, Shinobi, Valais

Exploratory Data Analysis

Distribution of Moves by Condition

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Condition, y = Moves, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 2) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 1.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Pre-Cocaine" = "#5DCAA5", "Post-Cocaine" = "#378ADD")) +
  labs(
    title   = "Distribution of moves per game: pre vs. post cocaine",
    x       = "Condition",
    y       = "Number of moves",
    caption = "Each point represents one participant"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

Distributional Spread by Island Across Conditions

ggplot(df_long, aes(x = city, y = Moves, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Pre-Cocaine" = "#5DCAA5", "Post-Cocaine" = "#378ADD")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distributional spread of moves per island across conditions",
    x     = "Island",
    y     = "Number of moves",
    fill  = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

Mean Moves Per Condition

means_condition <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Moves), SE = sd(Moves) / sqrt(n()))

ggplot(means_condition, aes(x = Condition, y = Mean, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), width = 0.08) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean number of moves per condition",
    x     = "Condition",
    y     = "Mean moves"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

Mean Move Difference by Island

island_means <- df %>%
  group_by(city) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Diff = mean(move_diff)) %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Mean_Diff >= 0, "Increase", "Decrease"))

ggplot(island_means,
       aes(x = reorder(city, Mean_Diff), y = Mean_Diff, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Increase" = "#378ADD", "Decrease" = "#E24B4A")) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean change in moves (post minus pre) by island",
    x     = "Island",
    y     = "Mean move difference",
    fill  = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

Win Rate by Condition

win_rates <- data.frame(
  Condition = factor(c("Pre-Cocaine", "Post-Cocaine"),
                     levels = c("Pre-Cocaine", "Post-Cocaine")),
  Wins   = c(sum(df$pre_win),       sum(df$post_win)),
  Losses = c(sum(1 - df$pre_win),   sum(1 - df$post_win))
) %>%
  pivot_longer(Wins:Losses, names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "Count")

ggplot(win_rates, aes(x = Condition, y = Count, fill = Outcome)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), vjust = -0.4, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Wins" = "#1D9E75", "Losses" = "#D85A30")) +
  labs(
    title = "Win and loss counts by condition",
    x     = "Condition",
    y     = "Count",
    fill  = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

Interaction Plot: Move Difference by Island and Sex

interaction_data <- df %>%
  group_by(city, sex) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Diff = mean(move_diff), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(interaction_data,
       aes(x = city, y = Mean_Diff, color = sex, group = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("female" = "#7F77DD", "male" = "#1D9E75")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    title = "Interaction plot: mean move difference by island and sex",
    x     = "Island",
    y     = "Mean move difference (post - pre)",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

t_result <- t.test(df$post_moves, df$pre_moves, paired = TRUE)

outcome_table <- matrix(
  c(sum(df$pre_win),      sum(1 - df$pre_win),
    sum(df$post_win),     sum(1 - df$post_win)),
  nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(Condition = c("Pre-Cocaine", "Post-Cocaine"),
                  Outcome   = c("Win", "Loss"))
)

kable(outcome_table,
      caption  = "Contingency table: win/loss by condition",
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
                full_width = FALSE)
Contingency table: win/loss by condition

Post-Cocaine 102 33 
chi_result <- chisq.test(outcome_table)

aov_model <- aov(move_diff ~ city + sex, data = df)
summary(aov_model)
##              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
## city          6   3956   659.3   1.532  0.173
## sex           1    173   172.9   0.402  0.527
## Residuals   127  54648   430.3
Two-way ANOVA results: move difference ~ island + sex
Source df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value p-value
Island (city) 6 3728.1 621.4 1.44 0.2030
Sex 1 172.9 172.9 0.40 0.5273
Residuals 127 54648.4 430.3 NA NA
R² decomposition: move difference ~ island + sex
Metric Value
SS (Island) 3955.9380
SS (Sex) 172.9250
SS (Residuals) 54648.3960
SS (Total) 58777.2590
R² 0.0702 
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(aov_model, which = 1, main = "Residuals vs. fitted values",
     pch = 20, col = "#378ADD80")
plot(aov_model, which = 2, main = "Normal Q-Q plot",
     pch = 20, col = "#378ADD80")
plot(aov_model, which = 3, main = "Scale-location plot",
     pch = 20, col = "#378ADD80")
plot(aov_model, which = 4, main = "Cook's distance",
     pch = 20, col = "#D85A3080")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(residuals(aov_model))
print(shapiro_result)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  residuals(aov_model)
## W = 0.98674, p-value = 0.2191
